_doc: Corporate actions (session-lanes.md §3.4, D-057), read by services/ops/src/runtime/session-events.ts and re-read when this file changes (no restart). A malformed entry is dropped and listed in the heartbeat.

skips[]: { "symbol": "TSLA", "date": "YYYY-MM-DD" (ET), "why": "3-for-1 split", "lanes": ["regular", "gap", "token"] (optional; omitted = every lane) }. Core skipApplies: a Regular Window matches on its start's ET date, a Gap on its Friday or its Monday (start or expiry ET date), a token Window on either boundary's ET date. A match pauses that lane: 'paused: corporate action (<why>)'.

multipliers[]: { "xstock": "TSLAx", "effectiveSec": <unix seconds>, "from": "1", "to": "3", "why": "TSLAx 3-for-1 multiplier" }. Decimals stay strings exactly as the issuer publishes them. Core multiplierApplies: the token lane skips a Window whose (tradingStart, expiry] contains effectiveSec.
Entries are proposed by `pnpm exec tsx scripts/drive/corporate-check.ts` (xStocks multiplier API, Finnhub splits) and committed by a person; nothing writes this file automatically.
